home.banner: Top Pocket Decks is alive and well, with a new maintainer keeping it updated. Rankings are current for {{expansion}} as of {{date}}.

windDown.headline: Premium is temporarily halted 💛
windDown.status: Top Pocket Decks has a new maintainer and will continue to receive updates! During this transition, new Premium signups are temporarily paused and ads have been switched off for everyone.
windDown.active: Your subscription stays active and keeps renewing until you cancel it. You can cancel any time through the billing portal.
windDown.refund: Would you rather have a refund? Email me at <0>chase@manning.dev</0> with the email address on your account and I'll cancel your subscription and refund your most recent payment. Stripe only lets me refund payments made in the last 180 days, so if yours is older than that I'll do whatever I can.

removeAds.title: Remove Ads
removeAds.description: Enjoy an experience without ads across the whole site.

bestDeckFinder.title: Best Deck Finder
bestDeckFinder.description: Find the strongest deck you can build with your cards. It doubles as a complete PTCGP collection tracker.

exclude.title: Exclude Cards You Don't Have
exclude.description: Filter out cards you do not own to live update the tier list with what you have.

matchups.title: Deck Strengths and Weaknesses
matchups.description: See which decks your build beats and loses to, including win rate percentages.

filters.title: Deck Filters
filters.description: Filter decks by Energy or ban EX cards entirely to beat solo battles.

sortBy.title: Alternative Rankings
sortBy.description: Change the tier list to rank by popularity or strength.

contact.title: Contact Developers
contact.description: Email the developers to give feedback on the site, request new features, or report bugs. Feature requests are not guaranteed, but we read them all.

updated.title: Tier List Updated
updated.description: How often the tier list pulls in new data. Faster updates help you stay ahead of the meta.

decks.title: Decks on Tier List
decks.description: Number of decks shown in the tier list. More decks means more options for you to choose from. Discover strong decks that haven't yet become popular.

adblocker.middle: your privacy? If you're not sure, I and many others can recommend
adblocker.footer: Obviously not sponsored. Just a genuine concern from a fellow like-minded individual.

deckPage.deckFinderHeader: Click on cards you do not have. The deck will update to show the best options with your available cards.
deckPage.notEnoughBody: That's one card too many. We can't imagine this deck without {{card}}.
deckPage.extinctBody: That was the last copy of {{card}}. There is no version of this deck left to build.
deckPage.extinctBodyNoCard: Every version of this deck needs a card you have marked as missing. There is nothing left to build.
deckPage.powerScoreTooltip: Expected win rate against the current field, weighted by how often you meet each deck. 50 is an even win rate. 100 is the strongest deck in the field.
deckPage.cardScoreTooltip: How strong this deck's individual cards are, scored across every tournament list. This measures card quality only, not win rate, and does not affect the tier.
deckPage.popularityTooltip: Qualified games in the last 14 days, capped at this expansion's release
deckPage.metaShareTooltip: Share of qualified games ± weekly change

statistics.noTrends: Trend data is unavailable right now.
statistics.noMovement: No deck movement in this window.

bestDeckFinder.title: Find Your Best Deck
bestDeckFinder.description1: Find the strongest deck you can build with your collection. The Best Deck Finder starts by showing you the top deck in the game. Click any cards you do not have, and it shows you the next best deck that skips those cards.
bestDeckFinder.description2: Keep removing cards until you find a deck where you have everything. The relative strength indicator shows you how powerful your deck is compared to the best deck in the game.

hero.title: Pokemon TCG Pocket Best Decks and Tier List
hero.subtitle: Find the strongest Pokemon TCG Pocket decks using real tournament data. You can filter full lists, mark the cards you lack, and see exactly what to build next. Dominate the meta.

tournamentResults.title: Tournament Results
tournamentResults.description: The tier list relies on tournament results. An algorithm determines the tier and decklist.

weeklyUpdates.title: Weekly Updates
weeklyUpdates.description: The tier list updates weekly, bringing new decks and matchups every Monday.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Filter decks by Energy or no Ex cards, useful for helping beat some of those Solo Battles

missingCards.title: Missing Cards
missingCards.description: Click on any cards you lack, and the tier list updates automatically for what you own.

matchups.title: Matchups
matchups.description: See matchup data for which decks beat others, alongside their win rates.
